causal_population_rule: After fresh support mapping, include all canonical SBS-vs-P6 disagreement states in mechanically selected valid fresh regimes.

stages: first valid pressure setting where canonical disagreement appears
first sustained-disagreement pressure setting under the Phase-B sustained rule
strongest valid preregistered pressure setting before invalidity/truncation
regime_selection_rule.deduplication: If onset, sustained, and high-valid are the same cell, label it once.
regime_selection_rule.arrival_axis: Arrival-pressure cells remain structural controls if no canonical disagreement occurs; they are not causal-label cells without support.

labeling_scope_rule.continuation_count_definition: one SBS reference per disagreement state plus one continuation per unique non-SBS canonical branch

one_step_intervention.reference: SBS branch from the same live state
one_step_intervention.counterfactual: force exactly one unique non-SBS canonical action once
one_step_intervention.continuation: immediately revert to fixed SBS / kv_constrained_online

integrity_requirements: original live simulator/state is not mutated
future arrivals identical across reference and counterfactual
SBS reference continuation reproduces native SBS continuation
duplicate canonical alternatives are not relabeled
pressure configuration persists identically across branches
forbidden: using Phase-D V1 latency signs or magnitudes
changing regime selection after causal outcomes
